description: Household Essentials open top market basket is the perfect handheld basket for filling to overflowing! the rectangular basket has a flat base and gently tapered sides. The taper creates a spacious basket that is easy to carry. 2 handles anchor by metal hooks to the basket's frame for a strong attachment that still moves. 2 handles that move keep the basket balanced when filled. The basket's horizontal weave is close and even, for a beautiful basket that is charming in its simplicity. Handwoven from naturally bright Willow, it is a basket that is sure to you're your needs-whether hauling produce from the farmer's market or as a catch-all in the kitchen, or a stylish activity organizer for the car to keep passengers entertained. The basket is 6.7 inches high (handles down) x 15 inches wide x 11.02 inches deep. Note: Household Essentials wicker and bamboo are handmade and may vary in color and size from image and Description.
